title: CONNECT-IP ROUTE_ADVERTISEMENT Capsule Architecture
purpose: Define RFC 9484 ROUTE_ADVERTISEMENT capsule wire format, route range validation, supersession, overlap policy, and protocol-number scoping helpers.
design_summary: `Http3ConnectIpRouteAdvertisementCapsule` creates and parses Capsule Type 0x03, validates IP Address Range field layout, enforces route ordering and non-overlap, models supersession and withdrawal semantics, and maps malformed advertisements to HTTP/3 message errors. `Http3ConnectIpRouteRange` owns IP version, address-ordering, protocol-zero, ICMP exception, and extension-header protocol-number policy used by CONNECT-IP scoping.
data_and_state_considerations: The codec is stateless. Supersession and withdrawal helpers operate over caller-provided snapshots so adapters can store route state at the request-stream boundary.
edge_cases_and_constraints: ROUTE_ADVERTISEMENT capsules may contain zero route ranges.
Routes are ordered by IP version, IP protocol, then strictly non-overlapping address ranges.
Malformed field layout, unsupported IP versions, invalid address order, and overlapping routes map to request-stream abort policy.
risks: HTTP Datagram payload conversion and forwarding remain separate RFC 9484 slices.
Live route-state integration remains adapter work.
